# Pi 5 firmware config. Generated by Buildroot; do not hand-edit on the rover.
arm_64bit=1
kernel=Image
arm_boost=1
disable_overscan=1
dtparam=audio=off
# Pi 5 BT is wired through RP1; `disable-bt` here just turns the
# Bluetooth controller off, no UART rerouting (that was Pi 4 behavior).
dtoverlay=disable-bt
dtparam=i2c_arm=on
dtparam=spi=on
# Pi 5 PL011 UART on GPIO 14/15. On Pi 5 this lives in the RP1 I/O
# chip and is exposed as `uart0` in the device tree, materializing as
# /dev/ttyAMA0 when enabled. The base DTB defaults this node to
# `status = "disabled"` — `dtparam=uart0=on` flips it to "okay" so
# waypoint-core can open /dev/ttyAMA0 for the STS3215 servo bus.
# `enable_uart=1` is the legacy alias that on Pi 5 also enables the
# primary GPIO UART; we keep both belt-and-suspenders. The Pi 5
# dedicated debug UART stays at /dev/ttyAMA10 (firmware adds
# console=ttyAMA10,115200 automatically), so the console doesn't
# fight us for ttyAMA0.
enable_uart=1
dtparam=uart0=on
core_freq_min=500

# A/B selection: swupdate edits this line to switch the active rootfs.
# Generated by post-build.sh from cmdline.txt.in.
cmdline=cmdline.txt
